minimality.method: Independent compulsory-vertex witnesses, not neighborhood smoothing.
minimality.proof: Every one of the 55 residue vertices must itself change to achieve exact zero. Each of the 18 disjoint continuity vertices is the immutable endpoint of a support-incompatibility witness whose lower bound already exceeds 0.5/1.0 even if all existing244 are free. Omitting any listed point preserves its witness. No unproved closure vertices are added.
minimality.minimality_scope: Necessary additional permissions for strict zero and the unqualified absolute support conflicts among the specified64 blockers; not proof of a unique future weight field.
minimality.sufficiency_claim: No claim that a future generated R2 automatically passes. Existing244 must also repair their introduced defects; all incident/outer seams, max4, normalization, geometry and targeted validation still apply. Any later proven new conflict needs another explicit approval, never automatic expansion.
